purpose: Cover the --fbs filter on rcf verify run (brief and deterministic ledger scoped to the bound criteria, report scope fields), the finalise default filter and --all escape, the ADR-4112 invariant over the scoped set with the zero-AC refusal, and the help, render and docs surfaces.
title: Finalise per-FBS verify scope: verify run --fbs filter, finalise default and --all, scoped verified invariant, help and docs

testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-fbs-scope.test.js::finalise: passes its own FBS as the verify filter by default; --all passes no filter

testCases.description: verified invariant over the scoped set: skipped in scope refuses, skipped outside scope promotes, zero-AC FBS refused
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/finalise-fbs-scope.test.js::finalise: the verified invariant is evaluated over the scoped set (skipped AC in scope refuses, skipped AC outside scope does not, zero-AC FBS refused)
